    UNION ALL
    SELECT id, away_team_api_id, 'away', away_player_11 FROM Match WHERE away_player_11 IS NOT NULL
),
match_results AS (
    SELECT 
        mp.player_api_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN mp.side = 'home' AND m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 'win'
            WHEN mp.side = 'home' AND m.home_team_goal < m.away_team_goal THEN 'loss'
            WHEN mp.side = 'away' AND m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 'win'
            WHEN mp.side = 'away' AND m.away_team_goal < m.home_team_goal THEN 'loss'
            ELSE 'draw'
        END AS result
    FROM match_players mp
    JOIN Match m ON m.id = mp.id
    WHERE m.home_team_goal IS NOT NULL AND m.away_team_goal IS NOT NULL
),
player_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        player_api_id,
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'win' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS win_count,
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'loss' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS INTEGER) AS loss_count
    FROM match_results
    GROUP BY player_api_id
),
top_wins AS (
    SELECT player_api_id, win_count, loss_count
    FROM player_stats
    ORDER BY win_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
top_losses AS (
    SELECT player_api_id, win_count, loss_count
    FROM player_stats
    ORDER BY loss_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    'Most Wins' AS category,
    pw.player_api_id,
    p1.player_name,
    pw.win_count AS total_wins,
    pw.loss_count AS losses_in_winning_player
FROM top_wins pw
JOIN Player p1 ON p1.player_api_id = pw.player_api_id
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'Most Losses',
    tl.player_api_id,
    p2.player_name,
    tl.win_count AS wins_in_losing_player,
    tl.loss_count AS total_losses
FROM top_losses tl
JOIN Player p2 ON p2.player_api_id = tl.player_api_id;
